mod.overview: Striker MOD 082499 Beta (Harold 'LabRat' Brown, August 1999) keeps Base's 52-item roster and movement physics intact while dynamically scaling weapon damage by the attacker's armor weight: Light deals 75%, Medium deals 100%, and Heavy deals 125%.
notes: Custom firing hooks (BlasterImage::onFire, ChaingunImage::onFire, PlasmaGunImage::onFire, GrenLauncherImage::onFire, DiscLauncherImage::onFire) strip static projectileType bindings and spawn projectiles manually with %damMod = 0.75 (Light), 1.0 (Medium), or 1.25 (Heavy).
Trades Light Armor's hit-and-run speed for reduced offensive output while rewarding Heavy Armor positioning with a 25% weapon damage bonus.

Blaster.summary: Fires via BlasterImage::onFire so Light Armor deals 75% damage, Medium 100%, and Heavy 125%.
notes: Datablock omits static projectileType so script-side damage scaling applies on spawn.

Chaingun.summary: Fires via ChaingunImage::onFire with armor-scaled bullet damage (0.75x Light, 1.0x Medium, 1.25x Heavy).
notes: Preserves Base fire rate while tying per-round lethality to armor class.

PlasmaGun.summary: Fires via PlasmaGunImage::onFire with armor-scaled bolt damage (0.75x Light, 1.0x Medium, 1.25x Heavy).
notes: Medium remains baseline while Heavy hits harder.

GrenadeLauncher.summary: Fires via GrenLauncherImage::onFire with armor-scaled shrapnel damage (0.75x Light, 1.0x Medium, 1.25x Heavy).
notes: Datablock projectileType cleared for script-side scaling.

DiscLauncher.summary: Fires via DiscLauncherImage::onFire with armor-scaled disc damage (0.75x Light, 1.0x Medium, 1.25x Heavy).
notes: Makes Heavy midairs and splash 25% stronger than Base.
